annotations.title: Stage one room from several angles

description: Virtually stage 2 to 10 photos of the SAME room, taken from different angles, so every photo gets the same furniture in the same places. Stages the first photo in the given style, then furnishes every other angle from it (or from referenceImageUrl if the room is already staged). Use this instead of calling pedra_furnish per photo whenever the user has several shots of one room: pedra_furnish would give each photo different furniture. Put the widest shot first. Costs 1 credit for the first photo and 2 per extra angle. Runs in the background: returns a jobId right away; call pedra_get_furnish_same_room with it until status is ready.

imageUrls.description: 2 to 10 photos of one room, widest shot first: public https:// URLs, data: URIs, or absolute paths to local image files on this computer. One room per call: stage the living room and the bedroom as separate calls.

preserveAspectRatio.description: By default the output comes back at whatever size the AI model produces, which may not match the input's aspect ratio or resolution. Set to true to get the result at the exact width and height of the input image (center-cropped to the original aspect ratio, never stretched). Defaults to false.

propertyId.description: Optional id of the Pedra property (from pedra_list_properties) this photo belongs to. When set, the result is saved into that property's gallery — visible and editable from the app — instead of only being returned as a URL.

referenceImageUrl.description: Optional public URL of a photo of this room that is already staged. Every photo in imageUrls is then furnished to match it (2 credits each) and style is ignored.

style.description: Style for the first photo, e.g. "Minimalist", "Scandinavian". Required unless referenceImageUrl is set.
